home.title: See the bad air coming. Look after the people breathing it.
home.description: Aethera forecasts Delhi NCR air quality for the next 72 hours, with weather and smoke affecting each other. Then it watches over the people most at risk, on their own phone, and tells their family when it matters.
home.disclaimer: Support tool, not a medical device. In an emergency call 112.
